```yaml
name: Build Plugins

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, dev]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, dev]
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}

jobs:
  build-plugins:
    name: Build Plugins
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Validate source structure
        run: |
          # Ensure source directories exist
          if [ ! -d "src/agents" ] || [ ! -d "src/skills" ]; then
            echo "❌ Source directories missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✅ Source structure validated"

      - name: Build plugins
        run: |
          # Create build directory
          mkdir -p build/
          
          # Run build script
          ./scripts/build-plugins.sh
          
          # Verify build output
          if [ ! -d "plugins/ork" ]; then
            echo "❌ Build failed: plugins/ork directory not created"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "✅ Plugins built successfully"

      - name: Validate built plugins
        run: |
          # Check that built plugins have correct structure
          if [ ! -f "plugins/ork/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" ]; then
            echo "❌ Missing plugin.json in built plugin"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Validate JSON syntax
          if ! jq empty "plugins/ork/.claude-plugin/plugin.json"; then
            echo "❌ Invalid JSON in plugin.json"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check that no symlinks exist in built plugins
          if find "plugins/ork" -type l | grep -q .; then
            echo "❌ Symlinks found in built plugin - this breaks installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "✅ Built plugins validated"

      - name: Upload built plugins as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: built-plugins
          path: plugins/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Run plugin validation tests
        run: |
          # Test that the built plugin works correctly
          cd plugins/ork
          
          # Validate plugin manifest
          if ! jq -e '.name and .version and .description' .claude-plugin/plugin.json > /dev/null; then
            echo "❌ Invalid plugin manifest"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Count skills and agents
          SKILL_COUNT=$(find . -name "*.py" -path "*/skills/*" | wc -l)
          AGENT_COUNT=$(find . -name "*.md" -path "*/agents/*" | wc -l)
          
          echo "Built plugin contains $SKILL_COUNT skills and $AGENT_COUNT agents"
          
          # Verify minimum counts
          if [ "$SKILL_COUNT" -lt 10 ]; then
            echo "❌ Too few skills in built plugin"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if [ "$AGENT_COUNT" -lt 5 ]; then
            echo "❌ Too few agents in built plugin"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "✅ Plugin validation passed"

  # Test that the build process produces installable plugins
  test-installation:
    name: Test Plugin Installation
    needs: build-plugins
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download built plugins
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: built-plugins
          path: plugins/

      - name: Simulate installation process
        run: |
          # Create a mock installation environment
          mkdir -p /tmp/test-installation
          cd /tmp/test-installation
          
          # Copy built plugin to simulate installation
          cp -r ${{ github.workspace }}/plugins/ork .
          
          # Verify installation integrity
          if [ ! -d "ork" ]; then
            echo "❌ Installation failed: plugin directory missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check that all expected files exist
          if [ ! -f "ork/.claude-plugin/plugin.json" ]; then
            echo "❌ Installation failed: plugin.json missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify no broken symlinks
          BROKEN_SYMLINKS=$(find ork -type l ! -exec test -e {} \; -print 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
          if [ "$BROKEN_SYMLINKS" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "❌ Installation contains broken symlinks"
            find ork -type l ! -exec test -e {} \; -print
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "✅ Plugin installation simulation successful"
```
